scope: Acceptance budgets for the static emulator bundle served over HTTP. The download byte limits scale with full-application (Phase 4) coverage; the live per-profile timing budgets below are the real UX guardrails and are unchanged.

notes.first_frame_ms: globalThis.emulator.measurements.startupMs: module script start to the first painted frame, including the WebAssembly download and instantiation.
notes.page_load_to_first_frame_ms: Harness wall clock from navigation until three frames are painted; includes browser navigation and document parsing.
notes.average_frame_ms: Mean of _emu_tick plus framebuffer conversion and putImageData, measured only across a realistic-speed simulated scan. Browser paint and compositing are excluded.
notes.peak_frame_ms: Largest single render callback of the session, including the first frame after initialization.
notes.wasm_memory_bytes: module.HEAPU8.byteLength: current committed WebAssembly linear memory, not live allocations. Memory can grow beyond its initial size.
notes.throttling: Chromium DevTools Protocol Emulation.setCPUThrottlingRate and Network.emulateNetworkConditions. This approximates a mid-range phone on a mobile network; it is not a measurement on physical hardware.

download.comment: Raw uncompressed file sizes. HTTP transfer is gzipped to roughly 40% of these (emulator.wasm ~1.03 MB raw is ~0.41 MB on the wire). Limits carry headroom for the remaining Phase 4 domain slices; runaway growth still trips the mobile first_frame_ms and page_load budgets.

desktop.description: Unthrottled Chromium on the developer workstation over localhost.

mobile.description: Mid-range phone approximation: 4x CPU throttling and a 9 Mbit/s, 150 ms-latency link.
